background_image_description: Soft pastel pink paper texture with a gentle gradient transitioning from a lighter pink at the top-left (#fad9e0) to a slightly deeper pink at the bottom-right (#e6aeb9), subtle grain and diffuse vignette.

nodes.asset_description: Photorealistic front view of a modern black smartphone (iPhone-style) centered on the canvas. It has a slim black bezel, rounded corners, and a wide top notch with a small camera/earpiece opening. The screen content is white, and the device casts a soft shadow on the pink background.

nodes.svg_description: Simple dark blue-gray line icon centered on the phone screen: an outlined envelope with a small notification bell at the top-right corner of the envelope flap. Clean geometric strokes with rounded caps, solid color #3f5361.

Modal card overlay with a white rounded rectangle (corner radius ~44px). Across the card near the bottom is a thin horizontal divider line in pale pink (#efd9dc). Centered below that divider, a thin vertical line splits the bottom area into two equal buttons. The card has subtle drop shadow.
